content:
Ads will appear in Apple Maps in the United States and Canada later this summer. Ahead of the official rollout, Apple has disclosed more rules and restrictions regarding ads on Apple Maps.

Apple Maps ads are coming soon, and Apple has also revealed categories of ads that are banned from the platform

Apple first announced its plans to introduce ads on Apple Maps back in March of this year. At the time, the company said ads would appear at the top of search results, as well as in a brand new "Suggested Places" widget within the app.

Apple laid the groundwork for the feature, including the new "Suggested Places," back in May with iOS 26.5. However, the company has not announced an actual launch date for Apple Maps ads since then.

According to TechCrunch, Apple has now updated its "Apple Advertising Services" policy to include content related to Apple Maps.

The policy covers advertising standards for Apple services including Apple News, Stocks, and Maps, and includes a long list of content that is prohibited across all services, including violence, weapons, and drugs.

Of particular note is the Apple Maps section. Apple says there are three additional ad categories banned specifically for Apple Maps:

  • Home services: Ads that contain or directly or indirectly promote home services, including but not limited to plumbing, locksmiths, HVAC, pest control, roofing, or general contracting, are prohibited.
  • Bail bonds: Ads that contain or directly or indirectly promote services related to criminal pretrial release bail bonds or surety bonds are prohibited.
  • Crypto ATMs: Ads that contain or directly or indirectly promote cryptocurrency ATMs are prohibited.

Additionally, Apple says ads related to medical services will be evaluated on a "case-by-case" basis.

As TechCrunch points out, it's interesting that Apple is banning ads for the entire "home services" category outright. Home services is one of the main ad categories on Google Maps, but Apple seems to have zero interest in introducing that kind of ad on Apple Maps.

All of this points to Apple gearing up to launch ads in Apple Maps soon, although no specific launch date has been announced as of yet.

Readers can find the complete list of prohibited ad categories across all Apple services on Apple's website.
